== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L269-L289
   269  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   270    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   271    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   272    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   273    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   274    is closed) -/
   275    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   276      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   277    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   278    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   279      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   280    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   281    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   282    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   283    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   284    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   285    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   286    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   287      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   288      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   289      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L202-L210
   202  inductive InstallRun (pins : List NatOpPinSet) :
   203      List Declaration → (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) →
   204      (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → Prop where
   205    | nil (p : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) :
   206        InstallRun pins [] p p
   207    | cons {pd : Declaration} {ds : List Declaration} {p p₁ p' : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck}
   208        (h : installDeclStep mode pins p pd = .ok p₁)
   209        (rest : InstallRun pins ds p₁ p') :
   210        InstallRun pins (pd :: ds) p p'

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L278-L282
   278  def GroupChecked {pins : List NatOpPinSet} {ds : List Declaration}
   279      (e : InstalledEnv mode pins ds) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
   280    match e.pend[i]? with
   281    | some pc => ∃ s', checkPending mode e.fe pc {} = .ok ((), s')
   282    | none => True

== ConLeche/Kernel/Exclusive.lean#L6-L42
     6  # `withExclusive`: the reference-count read behind the walk memo
     7  
     8  **What it is.**  `withExclusive a k h` runs the continuation `k` on
     9  whether the object `a` is *exclusive* — single-threaded with reference
    10  count exactly 1, so that no other reference to it exists.  In the logic
    11  it is `k false` ("not known to be exclusive", the conservative answer);
    12  in compiled code `@[implemented_by]` substitutes `k
    13  (isExclusiveUnsafe a)`, the real count read off the object header
    14  (`Init/Util.lean`, `@[extern "lean_is_exclusive_obj"]`, a BORROWED
    15  parameter; `lean_is_exclusive` in `lean.h`).  A multi-threaded object
    16  (count `< 0`) and a persistent one (count `0` — the installed
    17  environment after the driver's `Runtime.markPersistent`) answer
    18  `false`, which is the safe side.
    19  
    20  **What justifies the substitution** is the obligation
    21  
    22  ```
    23  h : k true = k false
    24  ```
    25  
    26  — the continuation's value does not depend on the answer, so the
    27  compiled program computes the very value the definition names.  A
    28  caller may use the answer to choose *how* to compute a value, never
    29  *which* value.  `Init.Util`'s `withPtrAddr` is the same arrangement
    30  (`k 0` in the model, the address in the binary, the continuation
    31  address-blind by obligation), and `Bool` being two-valued makes
    32  `k true = k false` the whole of `∀ b₁ b₂, k b₁ = k b₂`.
    33  
    34  **What it is for.**  The per-walk memo tables of the substitution walks
    35  (`ConLeche/Cached/ExprOpsC.lean`) exist for one reason: a node reached
    36  twice — a shared sub-DAG — must be rebuilt once, so that the walk is
    37  `O(DAG)` and its OUTPUT stays shared.  A node with exactly one
    38  reference cannot be reached twice, so recording it is pure loss: the
    39  key, the entry, the probe.  The official kernel's `replace_fn`
    40  (`src/kernel/replace_fn.cpp`) therefore caches a node's replacement
    41  only when `!is_likely_unshared(e)` — the same read.  The walks memoise
    42  exactly the nodes this primitive reports shared.

== ConLeche/Term/Syntax.lean#L187-L218
   187  inductive Term where
   188    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   189    | bvar (i : Nat)
   190    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   191    | sort (u : Nat)
   192    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   193    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   194    /-- application -/
   195    | app (f a : Term)
   196    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   197    | lam (ty body : Term)
   198    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   199    | pi (ty body : Term)
   200    /-- `let _ := val; body`, **without the type**: the body is under one
   201    binder, read at the value -/
   202    | letE (val body : Term)
   203    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`, **without the type**: the interpretation is
   204    `⟦eqE a b⟧ = eqv ⟦a⟧ ⟦b⟧`, so soundness never constrains the type,
   205    and a census (task #237) found no definition and no theorem in any
   206    tier reading the slot the former used to carry.  It is gone; a
   207    producer that knows the type simply drops it. -/
   208    | eqE (lhs rhs : Term)
   209    /-- First field of a pair.  Carries **only** the subject: the pair's
   210    type arguments come from the typing premise `Γ ⊢ p : Σ A B`,
   211    not from the term — see the module docstring.  Interpreted by
   212    `sfst`, i.e. literally `interp`'s clause. -/
   213    | fst (e : Term)
   214    /-- Second field of a pair; the `fst` twin, interpreted by `ssnd`. -/
   215    | snd (e : Term)
   216    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
   217    | prf
   218    deriving Repr, Inhabited

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L134-L145
   134  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → Term → V
   135    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   136    | _, .sort u => univ u
   137    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   138    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   139    | ρ, .lam A b => lamV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   140    | ρ, .pi A B => piV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   141    | ρ, .letE v b => interp (cons (interp ρ v) ρ) b
   142    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   143    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   144    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   145    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L51-L81
    51  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → Term → Prop
    52    | ρ, .pi A B =>
    53      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    54      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B) ∧
    55      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (interp V (cons x ρ) B))
    56    | ρ, .lam A b =>
    57      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    58      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    59      ∃ B : V → V,
    60        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    61        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (B x))
    62    | ρ, .app f a =>
    63      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    64      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    65        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    66        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V)) ∧
    67        (v ≠ 0 → IsTy A)
    68    | ρ, .fst e =>
    69      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    70      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    71        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    72    | ρ, .snd e =>
    73      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    74      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    75        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    76    | ρ, .eqE a b => WellDenoted ρ a ∧ WellDenoted ρ b
    77    | ρ, .letE v b => WellDenoted ρ v ∧ WellDenoted (cons (interp V ρ v) ρ) b
    78    | _, .bvar _ => True
    79    | _, .sort _ => True
    80    | _, .const _ _ => True
    81    | _, .prf => True

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L138-L325
   138  /-! ### The substitution metatheory -/

   140  /-- Truthfulness through lifting. -/
   141  theorem WellDenoted_liftN (n : Nat) :
   142      ∀ (e : Term) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   143        WellDenoted V ρ (e.liftN n k) ↔ WellDenoted V (shiftE n k ρ) e := by
   144    intro e
   145    induction e with
   146    | bvar i =>
   147      intro k ρ
   148      simp only [Term.liftN_bvar]
   149      split <;> simp
   150    | sort u => intro k ρ; simp
   151    | const c us => intro k ρ; simp
   152    | app f a ihf iha =>
   153      intro k ρ
   154      rw [Term.liftN_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf, iha,
   155        interp_liftN, interp_liftN]
   156    | lam A b ihA ihb =>
   157      intro k ρ
   158      rw [Term.liftN_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA, interp_liftN]
   159      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   160        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   161        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   162          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl)))
   163      · rw [ihb, cons_shiftE]
   164      · rw [interp_liftN, cons_shiftE]
   165    | pi A B ihA ihB =>
   166      intro k ρ
   167      rw [Term.liftN_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA, interp_liftN]
   168      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   169        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   170        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)))
   171      · rw [ihB, cons_shiftE]
   172      · rw [interp_liftN, cons_shiftE]
   173    | letE v b ihv ihb =>
   174      intro k ρ
   175      rw [Term.liftN_letE, WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_letE, ihv,
   176        interp_liftN, ihb, cons_shiftE]
   177    | eqE a b iha ihb =>
   178      intro k ρ
   179      rw [Term.liftN_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, iha, ihb]
   180    | fst e ihe =>
   181      intro k ρ
   182      rw [Term.liftN_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe,
   183        interp_liftN]
   184    | snd e ihe =>
   185      intro k ρ
   186      rw [Term.liftN_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe,
   187        interp_liftN]
   188    | prf => intro k ρ; simp
   189  
   190  /-- Truthfulness through instantiation. -/
   191  theorem WellDenoted_inst :
   192      ∀ (e a : Term) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   193        WellDenoted V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a →
   194        (WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a k) ↔
   195          WellDenoted V (instE k (interp V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a) ρ) e) := by
   196    intro e
   197    induction e with
   198    | bvar i =>
   199      intro a k ρ ha
   200      show WellDenoted V ρ
   201          (if i < k then .bvar i
   202           else if i = k then Term.liftN k a else .bvar (i - 1)) ↔ _
   203      by_cases h : i < k
   204      · simp [ite_eq_left h]
   205      · by_cases h2 : i = k
   206        · simp only [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_left h2, WellDenoted_bvar, iff_true]
   207          exact (WellDenoted_liftN V k a 0 ρ).mpr ha
   208        · simp [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h2]
   209    | sort u => intro a k ρ _; simp [Term.inst]
   210    | const c us => intro a k ρ _; simp [Term.inst]
   211    | app f b ihf ihb =>
   212      intro a k ρ ha
   213      rw [Term.inst_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf a k ρ ha,
   214        ihb a k ρ ha, interp_inst, interp_inst]
   215    | lam A b ihA ihb =>
   216      intro a k ρ ha
   217      rw [Term.inst_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA a k ρ ha,
   218        interp_inst]
   219      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   220        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   221        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   222          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl)))
   223      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   224          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   225        rw [ihb a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   226      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   227          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   228        rw [interp_inst, shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   229    | pi A B ihA ihB =>
   230      intro a k ρ ha
   231      rw [Term.inst_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA a k ρ ha,
   232        interp_inst]
   233      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   234        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   235        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)))
   236      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   237          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   238        rw [ihB a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   239      · rw [interp_inst, shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   240    | letE v b ihv ihb =>
   241      intro a k ρ ha
   242      rw [Term.inst_letE, WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_letE, ihv a k ρ ha,
   243        interp_inst]
   244      refine and_congr Iff.rfl ?_
   245      have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0
   246          (cons (interp V (instE k (interp V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a) ρ) v) ρ)) a := by
   247        rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   248      rw [ihb a (k + 1) _ ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   249    | eqE x y ihx ihy =>
   250      intro a k ρ ha
   251      rw [Term.inst_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, ihx a k ρ ha,
   252        ihy a k ρ ha]
   253    | fst e ihe =>
   254      intro a k ρ ha
   255      rw [Term.inst_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe a k ρ ha,
   256        interp_inst]
   257    | snd e ihe =>
   258      intro a k ρ ha
   259      rw [Term.inst_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe a k ρ ha,
   260        interp_inst]
   261    | prf => intro a k ρ _; simp [Term.inst]
   262  
   263  /-- Substitution at the outermost binder — the β/ζ transport form. -/
   264  theorem WellDenoted_inst0 {e a : Term} {ρ : Nat → V}
   265      (ha : WellDenoted V ρ a) :
   266      WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a) ↔
   267        WellDenoted V (cons (interp V ρ a) ρ) e := by
   268    have h := WellDenoted_inst V e a 0 ρ (by rwa [shiftE_zero_zero])
   269    rwa [shiftE_zero_zero, instE_zero] at h
   270  
   271  /-- **ζ, graded**: a `let` interprets as its reduct, and with its value
   272  graded it is graded exactly when its reduct is.  Unconditional: no
   273  binder, so no regime. -/
   274  theorem interp_zeta (v b : Term) (ρ : Nat → V) :
   275      interp V ρ (.letE v b) = interp V ρ (b.inst v) := by
   276    rw [interp_letE, interp_inst0]
   277  
   278  theorem WellDenoted_zeta {v b : Term} {ρ : Nat → V}
   279      (hv : WellDenoted V ρ v) :
   280      WellDenoted V ρ (.letE v b) ↔ WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst v) := by
   281    rw [WellDenoted_letE, WellDenoted_inst0 V hv]
   282    exact and_iff_right hv
   283  
   284  /-! ### The graded β step
   285  
   286  At a redex that is not the point, from the subject's `WellDenoted`
   287  alone: the λ is not the point (`app_pt`), so it is a graph and the
   288  slot's function space is in the graph regime; the graph fixes its
   289  domain (`piR_dom_unique`), so the argument lies in the λ's domain, and
   290  β is `app_lamV`.  At the point there is nothing to show: the claims
   291  that read this are conditional on "not the point". -/
   292  
   293  /-- The λ's own membership, read off its clause: an abstraction whose
   294  body is bounded by a family of types is a member of that family's
   295  function space. -/
   296  theorem WellDenoted_lam_mem {A b : Term} {ρ : Nat → V}
   297      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.lam A b)) :
   298      ∃ B : V → V, interp V ρ (.lam A b) ∈ˢ piV (interp V ρ A) B ∧
   299        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (B x)) := by
   300    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at h
   301    obtain ⟨-, -, -, B, hfib, hty⟩ := h
   302    exact ⟨B, by rw [interp_lam]; exact lamV_mem hfib hty, hty⟩
   303  
   304  /-- **The graded β step** at a redex that is not the point. -/
   305  theorem WellDenoted_beta {A b a : Term} {ρ : Nat → V}
   306      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a))
   307      (hne : interp V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a) ≠ pt) :
   308      interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A ∧
   309      interp V ρ (.app (.lam A b) a) = interp V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   310      WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   311    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   312    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, v', A', B', hslot, hmem, -, -⟩ := h
   313    have hlne : interp V ρ (.lam A b) ≠ pt := by
   314      intro h0; apply hne; rw [interp_app, h0, app_pt]
   315    have hv' : v' ≠ 0 := by
   316      intro h0; subst h0; exact hlne (eq_pt_of_mem_piR_zero hslot)
   317    obtain ⟨-, -, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := (WellDenoted_lam V ρ A b).mp hlam
   318    have hgraph : interp V ρ (.lam A b) = graph (fun x => interp V (cons x ρ) b) (interp V ρ A) := by
   319      rw [interp_lam] at hlne ⊢; exact lamV_eq_graph hlne
   320    have hown : interp V ρ (.lam A b) ∈ˢ piR 1 (interp V ρ A) B := by
   321      rw [hgraph, piR_pos (by decide)]; exact graph_mem_piSet hfib
   322    have hAA : interp V ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique (by decide) hv' hown hslot
   323    have haA : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A := hAA ▸ hmem
   324    refine ⟨haA, ?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)⟩
   325    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, app_lamV haA, interp_inst0]

== ConLeche/Model/Env/EnvModel.lean#L36-L64
    36  structure EnvModel (env : Env) where
    37    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    38    wf : EnvWF env
    39    /-- the leaf valuation: each constant's reading at a level assignment -/
    40    acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → Term
    41    /-- every leaf is closed -/
    42    cval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    43      Term.Closed (acval n ψ)
    44    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    45    by their direct pins (V-free) -/
    46    basis_pinned : BasisPinnedTT env acval
    47    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    48    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    49    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    50    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    51    shared) -/
    52    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    53    /-- every leaf is closed, as a lifting equation -/
    54    acval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (k : Nat),
    55      (acval n ψ).liftN 1 k = acval n ψ
    56    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    57    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    58      env.find? n = some ci →
    59      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    60        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    61        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    62    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    63    acval_wellDenoted : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    64      WellDenoted V ρ (acval n ψ)

== ConLeche/Model/Claims.lean#L49-L125
    49  /-- Head normalisation, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    50  point (task #342, L9): the reduct is graded and equal where the subject
    51  is not the point. -/
    52  @[expose] def WhnfCoreClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    53      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    54    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    55      whnfCore μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    56      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    57      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    58      ∀ {ea ea' : Term},
    59        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    60        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    61        denote m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    62        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) →
    63        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    64            WellDenoted V ρ ea') ∧
    65          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    66            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    67  
    68  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    69  point (task #342, L9). -/
    70  @[expose] def WhnfClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    71      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    72    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    73      whnf μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    74      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    75      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    76      ∀ {ea ea' : Term},
    77        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    78        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    79        denote m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    80        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) →
    81        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    82            WellDenoted V ρ ea') ∧
    83          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    84            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    85  
    86  /-- Definitional equality, P currency, conditional on the point (task
    87  #342, L9): two sides that are not the point are equal.  A consumer
    88  comparing two types or two members of one type closes with
    89  `eq_of_IsTy_of_ne_pt` / `IsTy.eq_of_ne_pt`. -/
    90  @[expose] def DefEqClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    91      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    92    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    93      ConLeche.isDefEqCore μ env fuel d a b = .ok true →
    94      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    95      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
    96      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    97      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
    98      ∀ {aa ba : Term},
    99        CtxOk m φ d Δa a →
   100        CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
   101        denote m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
   102        denote m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
   103        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ aa) →
   104        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ba) →
   105        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   106          interp V ρ aa ≠ pt → interp V ρ ba ≠ pt →
   107          interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
   108  
   109  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
   110  type's truthfulness are *conclusions*, and
   111  the type denotes a type. -/
   112  @[expose] def InferClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   113      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   114    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
   115      inferTypeCore μ env fuel d e = .ok t →
   116      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   117      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   118      ∀ {ea ta : Term},
   119        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   120        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   121        denote m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   122        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) ∧
   123          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedTy V ρ ta) ∧
   124          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   125            interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

   101  inductive Red (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L334-L357
   334  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   335  
   336  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   337  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   338  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   339  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   340  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   341  readability of the terms, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   342  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   343  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   344  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   345  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   346  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   347  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   348  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   349  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   350  types are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   351  `proofFast` *reads* a head's stored data to decide "definitely a
   352  proof" — and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for
   353  every `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   354  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   355  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   356  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   357  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L429-L437
   429  /-- The certified structural-`Nat` operations.  Six of them
   430  (`add sub mul pow beq ble`) carry a literal fast path; `Nat.pred` is
   431  here without one — it has no fast path (official's `reduce_nat` folds
   432  nothing unary but `Nat.succ`), but `Nat.sub`'s recurrence
   433  `sub x (succ y) = pred (sub x y)` names it, so its own recurrences
   434  must be certified for `sub`'s literal fold to be sound. -/
   435  def natOpNames : List Name :=
   436    [natPredName, natAddName, natSubName, natMulName, natPowName,
   437     natBeqName, natBleName]

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L375-L392
   375  /-! ## Structural-Nat literal acceleration
   376  
   377  The official kernel accelerates the structural `Nat` operations on
   378  literals (GMP-backed there).  Here the fast path is *certified*: an
   379  operation participates only when its defining recurrence equations
   380  hold by definitional equality — checked once, at install: `checkDecl`
   381  positively rejects a nonstandard definition under one of these names,
   382  so *presence in the store is the certificate* (no runtime flag, no
   383  re-checking; a reduction-time re-check would in fact livelock — the
   384  certification's own `pred zero` equation re-enters the fast path).
   385  
   386  The certification runs in the environment *before* the operation is
   387  stored, on the equations with the operation's self-references replaced
   388  by its stored definition value (`Expr.substConst0`): running it
   389  after insertion would let the operation's own just-enabled fast path
   390  discharge its all-literal-argument equations (`pred zero ≡ zero`,
   391  `beq zero zero ≡ true`) vacuously — accepting definitions that
   392  disagree with the fast path on those points, which is unsound.  The

   110      if ← ops.isDefEq env 2 eq.1 eq.2 then

   112      else pure false

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L439-L454
   439  /-- The WF-recursive operations with a *pinned-declaration* certified
   440  fast path: at install, `checkDecl` compares the stream's definition
   441  against a vendored pin of the toolchain's own (helper-unfolded)
   442  definition by definitional equality, and then checks the pinned
   443  `Nat.ble`-guarded characterization certificates
   444  (`ConLeche/Kernel/NatOpPins.lean`) like theorem declarations — without
   445  installing them.  Presence in the store is therefore again the
   446  capability: a stored operation under one of these names has passed pin
   447  and certificates, or the install declined.  (The name is historic:
   448  the family started with `Nat.div`/`Nat.mod` and now covers every
   449  pin-certified WF-recursive kernel-accelerated `Nat` operation —
   450  `Nat.log2` left the list when its fast path did, official folding no
   451  unary operation but `Nat.succ`.) -/
   452  def natDivModNames : List Name :=
   453    [natDivName, natModName, natGcdName, natLandName, natLorName,
   454     natXorName, natShiftLeftName, natShiftRightName]

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L589-L603
   589  def natOpGuard (env : Env) (c : Name) : Bool :=
   590    natLitSupported env &&
   591    (natOpDeps c).all (fun n => match env.find? n with
   592      | some (.defnInfo cv _ _) => cv.levelParams.isEmpty
   593      | _ => false) &&
   594    (if c = natBeqName || c = natBleName || natDivModNames.contains c then
   595      (match env.find? boolTrueName with
   596        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   597            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   598        | none => false) &&
   599      (match env.find? boolFalseName with
   600        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   601            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   602        | none => false)
   603     else true)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L156
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
   134  
   135  namespace SetTheory
   136  
   137  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ∈ˢ " => Mem
   138  
   139  variable {V : Type u} [SetTheory V]
   140  
   141  /-- Subset, from membership. -/
   142  protected def Subset (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ˢ x → z ∈ˢ y
   143  
   144  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ⊆ˢ " => SetTheory.Subset
   145  
   146  theorem Subset.refl (x : V) : x ⊆ˢ x := fun _ hz => hz
   147  
   148  theorem Subset.trans {x y z : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ z) : x ⊆ˢ z :=
   149    fun w hw => h₂ w (h₁ w hw)
   150  
   151  theorem Subset.antisymm {x y : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ x) : x = y :=
   152    ext fun z => ⟨h₁ z, h₂ z⟩
   153  
   154  theorem mem_power_iff_subset {z x : V} : z ∈ˢ power x ↔ z ⊆ˢ x := mem_power
   155  
   156  end SetTheory

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L9-L38
     9  /-!
    10  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    11  
    12  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed rather than
    13  declined:
    14  
    15  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    16    installed as an *opaque* (stored `axiomInfo`, exactly like a checked
    17    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    18    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    19    interpretation.
    20  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    21    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    22    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at install their stored values are
    23    pinned against the identity function
    24    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, hand-pinned since task #273 —
    25    every toolchain's definition after zeta) by definitional equality —
    26    the task-#47 pattern: drift declines, never silently.
    27  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    28    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    29    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    30    definitional-equality certificate at the operation's own install,
    31    `checkReducePin`; the axiom's install checks `ofReduceAxOk`),
    32    `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    33    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    34    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    35  
    36  `sorryAx` remains the only axiom tolerated as a *declaration*: its
    37  record installs nothing and any use of it declines
    38  (`sorryAxName`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Basis/Names.lean`).

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L269-L289
   269  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   270    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   271    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   272    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   273    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   274    is closed) -/
   275    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   276      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   277    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   278    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   279      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   280    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   281    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   282    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   283    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   284    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   285    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   286    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   287      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   288      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   289      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L443-L448
   443  def checkDecls (mode : CheckMode) (pins : List NatOpPinSet)
   444      (ds : Array Declaration) :
   445      Except (CheckError × Nat) Env := do
   446    let p ← ds.foldlM (installDeclStep mode pins) (0, mkFEnv Env.empty, #[])
   447    checkPendingList mode p.2.1 p.2.2.toList
   448    pure p.2.1.env

== ConLeche/Frontend/Prepare.lean#L165-L172
   165  /-- **`preparePrelude`**: the parsed stream, prepared for the fold —
   166  the prelude's declarations first (the stream's own copies where it has
   167  them), the rest of the stream after them, every pinned `Nat`
   168  operation's stream-certified ground ahead of it.  Total, pure, and the
   169  fold's input — an array in and an array out, the shape the parse
   170  returns and the fold consumes. -/
   171  def preparePrelude (pre : PreludeIx) (ds : Array Declaration) : Array Declaration :=
   172    (prepareD pre ds).decls

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L133
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)

== bridge/lean4lean-model/ConLecheBridge/Carneiro.lean#L200-L202
